audit.whatIsWrong: The chart hands Irelia levels 2, 3 and first item, and calls level 1 even — but whys[0] says 'your Q-Vital poke wins the short trade outright', whys[1] says 'trades up — stay even-to-ahead', whys[2] says 'genuinely even', whys[5] says 'the lane stays even'. Packet levelChart: Fiora / Skill x5 / Irelia.
audit.why: Ionian Fervor has no stacks at level 1 and Flawless Duet is not available until 3, so Irelia has no CC and no attack-speed ramp while Fiora's Vital poke is already online. Through the mid levels Bladesurge resets off the wave cancel out Fiora's chained Lunges. Only at two items does the reset mobility plus stacked attack speed pull clear.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Fiora, Levels 2, 3 and First item -> Skill; Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items already correct. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered, and the level-6 one carries the actual sequence rather than a slogan. Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Bladesurge 10s falling to 6s at 15 mana, Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85s — the E cooldown is the one that matters and the page already tells the player to trade around it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields claim Defiant Dance soaks Fiora's R burst — whys[6] 'W's damage reduction soaks your R burst' and wants.foe[2] 'Time her W damage-reduction through your Bladework crit and R burst'. Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only.
audit.why: Kit text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Grand Challenge's Vital procs are true damage — flagged trueDamage in Fiora's kit, 'ignores armour and MR'. Nothing about Defiant Dance touches them. It does blunt her Bladework crit and her autos, which is the correct thing to tell the player.
audit.corrected: Restated as physical-only mitigation that never applies to Vital true damage, which changes the all-in maths in Fiora's favour rather than against her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bladesurge's heal is never mentioned anywhere in the content layer, so the reason extended trades slip away is unexplained.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags needs-antiheal for this matchup. Bladesurge 'dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself' and refreshes on a Marked or dying target, so on a big wave she heals repeatedly for 15 mana a cast. report[8] already prescribes early Executioner's Calling but the prose never says why.
audit.corrected: Named Bladesurge's healing and Grievous Wounds in whys[6] and late.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already right and precisely stated: Flawless Duet stuns enemies caught between the two converging blades, so it is an immobilise, so Riposte blocking it upgrades Fiora's stab to a stun — and spikes[1] correctly says to parry on the SECOND blade's cast, which is the timing that actually works. Also worth the player knowing, and now added: the E also Marks the target, which is what refreshes Bladesurge.

edits.before: This is HER window, not yours. You do not out-scale a fed Irelia, so the lane has to be won before then: snowball off your early levels, take the splitpush pressure while you can, and close it before her resets and item spike take over.

notes: Real error corrected: two fields told the player Defiant Dance soaks Fiora's ultimate burst. It reduces physical damage only, and Grand Challenge's Vital procs are true damage — so the mitigation the page was warning about does not exist, while the mitigation that DOES exist (against her Bladework crit and autos) went unmentioned. Second: Bladesurge's heal never appeared in the prose despite the itemisation already calling for early Executioner's Calling. Kit-flag caveat: Irelia's E carries a 'grounding' flag in the derived data, which if real would shut off Fiora's Lunge entirely and would be the most important line on the page — Riot's own description mentions only damage, stun and Mark, so per the brief's rule I asserted nothing and am flagging it for a manual check.
